questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is the:
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes.

questions.question: Which river is the longest in the world?
questions.explanation: The Nile is generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: The Nobel Prize is NOT awarded in which field?
questions.explanation: There is no Nobel Prize in Mathematics.

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: How many bones are there in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.explanation: The UK uses the Pound Sterling.

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: The Sun rises in the:
questions.explanation: Due to Earth’s west-to-east rotation, the Sun appears to rise in the east.

questions.question: The Davis Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Davis Cup is a men’s team tennis event.

questions.question: "Vidhan Sabha" refers to the:
questions.explanation: Vidhan Sabha is the State Legislative Assembly.

questions.question: Emperor Ashoka belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The study of living organisms is called:
questions.explanation: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is appointed by the:
questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of:
questions.explanation: The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is the:
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP), so they are the cell’s powerhouse.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the:
questions.explanation: The Vice-President chairs the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: The Western Ghats run parallel to which coast of India?
questions.explanation: The Western Ghats run along the western coast.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 12 days?
questions.explanation: 12 mod 7 = 5; Saturday + 5 = Thursday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 14th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 14th letter = N; 14 + 2 = 16th letter = P.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (6, 216), (2, 8), (4, 62), (9, 729)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 4³ = 64, not 62.

questions.question: In a row of 32 students, Ravi is 14th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 32 − 14 + 1 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 8, 13, 19, 26, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 8, so 26 + 8 = 34.

questions.question: If FISH is coded as HKUJ, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to SUN gives UWP.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 6:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 6:00 the angle is 6 × 30° = 180°.
The relation is squaring: 8² = 64, so 7² = 49.

questions.question: A person walks 5 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 7 + 4 × 3.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 7 × 4 − 3 = 28 − 3 = 25.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 13, 40, 121, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3 + 1: 121 × 3 + 1 = 364.

questions.question: Complete the series: C, E, G, I, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is K.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 20, 2, 3, 13
questions.explanation: 2, 13, 3 are prime numbers; 20 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 2nd letter from the right is the 25th from the left = Y.
The relation is cubing: 3³ = 27, so 3³ = 27.

questions.question: If today is Sunday, what day will it be after 82 days?
questions.explanation: 82 mod 7 = 5; Sunday + 5 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 6th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 6th letter = F; 6 + 4 = 10th letter = J.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (2, 8), (9, 729), (5, 129), (4, 64)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 5³ = 125, not 129.

questions.question: In a row of 45 students, Ravi is 27th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 45 − 27 + 1 = 19.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 37 + 13 = 50.

questions.question: If BOOK is coded as ERRN, how is BIRD coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to BIRD gives ELUG.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 5:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 5:00 the angle is 5 × 30° = 150°.
The relation is squaring: 5² = 25, so 9² = 81.

Find the compound interest on ₹10000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.

An article costing ₹520 is sold at a 5% profit. Find the selling price.

questions.explanation: Multiples: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15. Sum = 45. Average = 45/5 = 9.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 7 and their sum is 50. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 10. Each part = 50/10 = 5. Larger = 7 × 5 = 35.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/30 = 50/600. Time = 600/50 = 12 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 28 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √169.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹540. Find its marked price.
Find 50% of 20% of 1500.
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their difference is 24. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 24, so each part = 8. Smaller = 2 × 8 = 16.

questions.question: A boat travels 28 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 28/2 = 14 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 14 − 2 = 12 km/h.
